recipe_numbers_from_prose._note: Quoted from main.tex body text, section 'Finding emotion vectors'. These are the paper's own numbers, not ours; docs/design/sofroniew-recipe.md records where our run departs from them and why.
recipe_numbers_from_prose.capture_reduction: mean over story tokens from token 50 onward, per layer
recipe_numbers_from_prose.centering: subtract the mean activation across emotions
recipe_numbers_from_prose.confound_removal: project out the top PCs of activations on neutral dialogues, enough to explain 50% of the variance
recipe_numbers_from_prose.headline_layer: about two-thirds of the way through the model
